title: postgres-lifecycle-cascade-report acceptance evidence

preconditions.const: Operations: identity.admin.user-delete, identity.organization.delete; exact inputs: tenant_id, user_id, organization_id, expected_version; initial state: identity and organization aggregates have all declared dependent PostgreSQL rows

stimulus.const: Run identity.admin.user-delete then identity.organization.delete for success, failure, outage, concurrency, cleanup, unknown-outcome cases using tenant_id, user_id, organization_id, expected_version and capture every required artifact field
